model: 國立中正大學大禮堂前門廊段 — 三角玻璃背板限域外觀代理
scope: Only existing front porch/elevation section. No promotion to complete auditorium, no geometry change, main-repository mutation or physical-print certification.

source_evidence.source_date_correction: Independent EXIF read found front Original/Digitized 2003:08:09 17:18:21, side 2003:10:25 12:17:24. Their DateTime values are 2005:12:04 18:33:17 and 18:33:36 respectively, not exposure dates. No offset present and camera clock unverified; no UTC conversion. Official page itself does not label date. Builder corrected README, SOURCES, palette and generator text plus source-evidence before final hash binding.
source_evidence.side_photo_scope: Side photograph contains columns, brick wall and other windows but does not contain the selected triangular glass; explicitly not corroboration of its side/back surface.

visual_findings.front_source: Central lower gable is divided gray-blue glazing with a stone/concrete frame. Bright white reflected patch is not a separate white material. Photo supports only the front triangle, not other windows or brick bands.
visual_findings.front: Single broad gray-blue backplane appears through neutral projecting mullions and outer sloping frame. Front porch and other window recesses remain neutral. No added white reflection or photo texture.
visual_findings.rear: Plain sectional cut and all visible backs remain neutral; must not be called actual auditorium rear elevation.
visual_findings.elevation: Entire selected triangle has continuous gray-blue proxy; three projecting vertical frames and transverse frame remain neutral. No color spill into sloping cornices or main wall.
visual_findings.side: Section depth and open portico preserved; no spread into side cheeks or roofs.
visual_findings.top: All roofs, upper flats, portico top and base remain neutral.
visual_findings.all_five_views: Personally inspected final 1200x1200 images; no model/base crop. Independently projected all original vertices using manifest cameras and confirmed framing.
visual_findings.proxy_judgment: Acceptable substantial glazing-surface approximation, not a decorative counting spot. Opaque finish maintains existing printable solid; not a claim of real glass transmittance, composition or surveyed mullion dimensions.

geometry_and_selection.whole_face_boundary: All original triangles independently tested against 3D support plane y=-12.15 and three oriented edge halfspaces of vertices(-28,-12.15,55),(28,-12.15,55),(0,-12.15,74), with outward -Y orientation and 0.0002mm tolerance. Not centroid/bbox only and not a hard-coded index selection. Sole resulting face is725.
geometry_and_selection.derivation: Original generator cut profile xz(-28,55),(28,55),(0,74), center y-13.5 and depth2.7 gives back plane y-12.15. Frame geometry is in front and not selected.
geometry_and_selection.exchange: Original seven bytes/SHA256/Git blobs checked; work/research/source STL byte-identical. Every 3MF triangle preserves exact original coordinates, order and winding; p1=p2=p3 whole-face assignment. Millimeter units, identity build transform, original 3522 count unchanged.
geometry_and_selection.materials: Neutral #AAA79FFF and opaque gray-blue #687C80FF, no subdivision, added geometry or changed frame material.
geometry_and_selection.original_native: Builder native audit reports one Warm stone material and original coordinate sets matching STL; reviewer rechecked original native bytes/Git hash but did not rerun Blender edit/save/reopen.

limitations: Partial front elevation/porch model remains partial. Rear sectional cut is not the real auditorium back.
Gray-blue is a source-bound uncalibrated opaque visual proxy, not measured glass material or transmittance.
2003 EXIF metadata and 2005 file-modification values do not establish 2026 current appearance.
Other 3521 neutral faces are unknown/out-of-scope, not evidence that the real building is gray. Mixed brick and stone bands cannot be safely colored on unsegmented original faces.
No white glare patch, additional glazing, fine material seams, or new geometry were invented.
No slicing, physical print or minimum-thickness/support guarantee. Historical geometry/print limitations remain.
builder_checks_summary: Read strict exchange/manifold and edit-save-reopen, native coordinate audit, Blend real material edit/save/reopen and clean-directory determinism reports. Reviewer independently recomputed raw STL/3MF exactness, full triangular bounds, original hashes, EXIF and camera framing.
packaging: PASS applies to these final frozen files. ZIP inclusion of report and independent checks will be separately verified on builder final package.
